weapons.name: Wailing Beam
weapons.desc: Taken from a ghost ship. It screams when it fires.

augments.name: Spectral Lantern
augments.desc: The fleet loses your trail: 6% evasion and 10% more scrap.

sectors.name: The Silent Graveyard
sectors.blurb: A battlefield nobody won. The wrecks still fight on their own.

events.text: Your comms pick up a voice reading out coordinates, over and over. The signal is three hundred years old.

effect.text: They lead to a beacon nearby.

success.text: The voice stops. Then: "Thank you." A cargo pod drifts out of the dark towards you.

fail.text: The voice gets louder. Every speaker on your ship screams at once.

events.text: The source of the signal: a vast dead warship, lights still blinking in a pattern. Its guns track you as you approach.

afterWin.text: With its guns silent, the warship's vault opens by itself.

choices.text: Broadcast the old Fedoration stand-down code.

success.text: Its guns lower. The ship lets you take what you need, then goes dark for good.

events.text: A derelict fighter with its canopy open. The pilot's seat is empty, but the engine is warm.

success.text: A good engine core. Your engineers are thrilled.

fail.text: The engine restarts on its own and flies off without you.

effect.text: You find a logbook and a lucky charm.

events.text: A cold mist seeps through your vents. Your crew report footsteps in empty corridors.

effect.text: The mist goes out the airlocks, and so does a little oxygen. Quiet returns.
{who} says the mist is only lonely. It leaves a gift as it goes.

fail.text: Something knocks a fuel canister out of the hold.
